items.title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
items.summary: Epoch AI researchers say the widely available AI model GLM 5.3 turned public security fixes into working exploits before updates reached Firefox users. It autonomously compromised six Firefox releases for about $1,000 in API fees each without triggering safeguards from any provider tested....

items.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
items.summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

items.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it....

items.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
items.summary: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

items.title: Presentation: The Ladder Is Missing Rungs: Engineering Progression When AI Ate the Middle
items.summary: Alasdair Allan discusses empirical research from METR and Anthropic on AI coding adoption. He explains the "supervision paradox," where reliance on AI tools disrupts junior skill development, risks institutional context loss, and threatens the long-term engineering pipeline needed to oversee autonomous systems effectively. By Alasdair Allan

items.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

items.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing With Cached Playwright Replays
items.summary: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. The agent associates test instructions expressed in natural language to actions on the user interface, caches those when appropriate for faster CI replays, remapping them to test specifications when the user interface changes. Verification is based on multi-model consensus and vision model evaluations. By Bruno Couriol

items.title: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
items.summary: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter....

items.title: OpenAI doubles usage limits on Pro plans as competition with Anthropic heats up
items.summary: OpenAI is doubling usage limits across its paid plans, from Pro 100 to Pro 500. A planned cut to the Pro 200 quota was reversed after user pushback. More efficient models like Terra and Sol should push usable capacity even higher. The move comes just ahead of Anthropic's IPO, as both companies fight for B2B dominance in AI....

items.title: How to Make Artificial Intelligence More Environmentally Sustainable
items.summary: IT is responsible for about 2 - 4% of all global emissions, and electricity use at Microsoft and Google has climbed because of AI, according to their own reports. Sustainability ought to be a top-level architectural concern. Some recommendations are: use pre-built and smaller models, run compute where low-carbon electricity is abundant, and train on renewable energy. By Ben Linders

items.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
items.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

items.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
items.summary: The first TPU in space is running a Google DeepMind Gemma 4 model and writing cheesy poetry.
